{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_summary = df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max().describe()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient (should be 1 or 2):\n{sample_seq_summary}")

# Inspect the first few rows of duplicated patients
duplicated_rows = df[df.duplicated(subset="patient_id", keep=False)].sort_values("patient_id")
duplicated_rows.head(10)"}
